t.zh: 工作台能读写每个像素，却只能照原样摆放：一张图要放大或缩小，它没有办法。缩放和取出一部分不同，要给新图的每个像素算出一个值；算值之前，先得知道这个像素落在原图的什么位置。
t.en: The workbench can read and write every pixel, but only where it already is: it cannot enlarge or shrink an image. Unlike taking out a part, resizing computes a value for every pixel of the new image; before any value, it must know where that pixel sits in the original.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：图像放大或缩小时，新图的每个像素对应原图的什么位置？约定是新旧两排像素一样长、像素中心对齐。第一个任务在格子上手算一行，第二个任务搭一块电路，交出整张新图的两张源坐标图，测试的坐标都对才算对。
t.en: This level asks: when an image is enlarged or shrunk, where in the original does each new pixel sit? The convention: the old and the new row are equally long and pixel centres are aligned. The first task works out one row by hand on the grid; the second wires a circuit that gives the whole new image's two source-coordinate images, right when every tested coordinate is.

desc.zh: 输入原图的宽 sw、高 sh 和新图的宽 nw、高 nh，输出新图每个像素在原图里的 x、y（两张坐标图）
desc.en: Takes the original's width sw and height sh and the new width nw and height nh; gives each new pixel's x and y in the original (two coordinate images)

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="sampling-grid"></wiki-ref>：每个新像素反向映射回原图，不把旧像素正向搬过去；各个库的对齐约定不同，要写明。
after.en: This is a <wiki-ref to="sampling-grid"></wiki-ref>: each new pixel mapped back into the original, not old pixels pushed forwards; libraries align differently, so the convention must be stated.

brief.zh: 这一行 2 像素宽，放大成 3 像素：写出每个新像素在原图里的 x。
brief.en: This row, 2 pixels wide, is enlarged to 3: write where each new pixel sits in the original, as x.

hint.zh: 把新旧两排画成等长的两条，各自的像素中心落在哪里？
hint.en: Draw the two rows as two bars of one length: where does each pixel centre fall?

after.zh: 新像素不是旧像素换了编号：中间那个落在两个旧像素之间。
after.en: New pixels are not old ones renumbered: the middle one falls between two old pixels.

label.zh: 新像素在原图里的 x

why.zh: 这是把新像素当成旧像素重新编号：原图这一行只有 x = 0 和 x = 1 两个像素，x = 2 落在原图外面。新旧两排一样长，三个新像素中心要分布在两个旧像素占的那段长度上。
why.en: That renumbers the new pixels as if they were old ones: the original row has pixels at x = 0 and x = 1 only, so x = 2 lies outside it. The two rows are equally long, so the three new centres spread over the length the two old pixels cover.

t.zh: 手算一行可以，一整张图要每个像素各算一遍，就要电路了：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去。新图的每个像素先要有自己的坐标，而手上没有元件能从两个数造出一整张图。
t.en: One row works by hand; a whole image, every pixel worked out, needs a circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right. Each new pixel first needs its own coordinates, and no part in hand makes a whole image out of two numbers.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>给定宽和高，给出每格就是自己 x、y 的两张坐标图。坐标还要换算：<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数，<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>对数和整张图逐个值地算。
t.en: The new part <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref> takes a width and a height and gives the two coordinate images whose cells hold their own x and y. The coordinates still need converting: <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> gives a fixed number, and <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>, <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref> work value by value on numbers and whole images.

brief.zh: 输入原图和新图的宽高：交出新图每个像素在原图里的 x 坐标图和 y 坐标图。
brief.en: Given the original's and the new width and height, give the image of each new pixel's x in the original, and the image of its y.

hint.zh: 先给新图的每个像素一对它自己的坐标。
hint.en: First give every pixel of the new image its own pair of coordinates.

hint.zh: 新图的一个像素宽，相当于原图的几个像素宽？像素中心和像素左边差多少？
hint.en: One pixel of the new image is how many pixels of the original wide? How far is a pixel's centre from its left edge?
